search_notes: Re-check 2026-10-09. QL1706-302 (QL1706 = iparomlimab and tuvonralimab, Qibeian; phase II/III vs camrelizumab, each with gemcitabine-cisplatin, first-line nasopharyngeal carcinoma): no disclosure of the PFS analysis found. Registry (API): status unknown, no results, not updated since 2023-11-22, one site. Europe PMC by NCT (8 records, reviews and phase 1 papers) and by title (QL1706 or iparomlimab + nasopharyngeal: 3, none this trial); Crossref titles containing QL1706 or iparomlimab (about 60 read, ASCO/ESMO abstracts to 2026): no randomised nasopharyngeal report; the phase II/III with data at ESMO 2024 (LBA38, DUBHE-H-308) is the liver-cancer sibling. Qilu is unlisted; its own news list was read back about 60 pages (qilu-pharma.com/news_lsit/6781560.html): QL1706 items are the cervical approval, the cervical phase 3 QL1706-301 meeting its endpoints, the new-indication filing accepted (item dated 2026-05-02, cervical first line; nasopharyngeal named only among tumours with 'phase II data') and an ASCO 2026 round-up (2026-06-03) with no nasopharyngeal study. One Chinese web search returned registry mirrors only. Not checked: China's CDE trial register. The trial may have stopped after its phase II part; no source says so.

Re-check 2026-10-09. FS-1502 (LCB14 / IKS014, licensed from LigaChem) vs T-DM1, Fosun: no disclosure found; the first trace's 'unclear' is replaced by 'no' because nothing read hints at a result. Registry (API): status unknown, no results, not updated since 2023-09-01. Fosun Pharma's Hong Kong filings: interim results of 26 Aug 2025 list FS-1502 as 'Chinese mainland: Phase III clinical trial'; annual results of 25 Mar 2026 and interim results of 25 Aug 2026 (https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0825/2026082502119.pdf) still list it in the pipeline chart for HER2-positive breast cancer with no remark, no filing and no result. All 67 of Fosun's drug notices of 2025-01 to 2026-10 (clinical-trial approvals and progress, registration acceptances and approvals) were opened: none concerns FS-1502. Europe PMC (title FS-1502/IKS014/LCB14: phase 1 papers only), Crossref titles (phase 1 only), EDGAR full text (0 hits). Two web searches (Chinese; Korean/English): no result; a Korean report opened (kormedi.com/2784571, 27 Jan 2026) says the phase 3 is 'nearing completion' with approval hoped for within the year. Estimated completion date (Jul 2025) is long past, so a readout could come at any time.

Re-check 2026-10-09. Linperlisib + CHOP vs CHOP, newly diagnosed PTCL (YY-20394-015), phase II/III: not read out; no evidence the trial has started. Registry (API): not yet recruiting, no sites listed, start date estimated, never updated since first posting on 2024-08-12; the registry completion date of 2024-12-31 cannot be the phase 3 PFS analysis (study completion 2029). Europe PMC by NCT (0) and title (linperlisib + CHOP/PTCL: relapsed-setting and phase 1 papers only); Crossref titles on linperlisib: the ASCO 2026 abstract 7004 (LINCH) is a single-arm phase Ib/II of linperlisib + CHOP, a sibling, not this trial. YingLi's own news list read (yl-pharma.com/cn/news.html, latest item 2026-04-29): nothing on this trial; its pipeline page shows PTCL in China at 'phase III / registration trial' with no result. One Chinese web search: registry mirrors only (a mirror of China's register shows 'not yet recruiting'; summary, not opened). Two primaries on the registry (ORR for the phase 2 part, PFS for phase 3).

Re-check 2026-10-09. SSGJ-707 (PF-08634404, PD-1/VEGF bispecific licensed to Pfizer) vs pembrolizumab, first-line PD-L1-positive NSCLC, China: not read out. Registry (API): recruiting, started 2025-06-20, no results, estimated completion 2026-07-30 (record last updated 2025-06-24). 3SBio's Hong Kong announcement titles from Apr 2025 to Oct 2026 (77, all listed) include the Pfizer licence notices and results documents but no trial readout; its interim results of 20 Aug 2026 (https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0820/2026082001637.pdf) mention 707 only as licensed out to Pfizer, no readout. Pfizer's Q2 2026 earnings release (8-K exhibit, 4 Aug 2026) names the 3SBio agreement only in its forward-looking statements. EDGAR full text for PF-08634404 and SSGJ-707: no result. Europe PMC and Crossref: phase 2 abstracts (ASCO 2026) and trial-in-progress items only. One web search (English and Chinese): no topline; phase 2 data only. Beware siblings: Pfizer's global phase 3s add chemotherapy or use other comparators.

Re-check 2026-10-09. TGRX-326 (deulorlatinib) vs crizotinib, China phase 3: not read out. Registry (API): active, not recruiting, 321 enrolled (actual), no results, estimated completion 2026-04-30, last updated 2025-05-18. Simcere holds mainland commercial rights; its annual results of 25 Mar 2026 say 'the phase III clinical study of Deulorlatinib has completed the LPI' and its interim results of 20 Aug 2026 (https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0820/2026082001845.pdf) say only 'In June 2026, the pre-NDA application of Deulorlatinib has been submitted': no phase 3 result in either. A pivotal single-arm phase 2 exists (J Thorac Oncol, Apr 2026; ASCO 2026 abstract 8638), so the pre-NDA step does not by itself imply a phase 3 readout. Europe PMC and Crossref titles on deulorlatinib/TGRX-326: phase 1, phase 2 and two editorials, no phase 3 report. One web search: nothing. TargetRx's own site (tjrbiosciences.com) has no news section that could be read; targetrx.com belongs to another company. Simcere Zaiming's listing application of 9 Jan 2026 has been withdrawn from the exchange site and was not read.

Re-check 2026-10-09. YK-029A (PH001) vs platinum chemotherapy, first-line EGFR exon 20 insertion NSCLC (SZPH-2023-001): no disclosure found. Registry (API): not yet recruiting, no results, never updated since 2023-04-05 (52 sites listed). Europe PMC by NCT (7 reviews) and title (YK-029A: phase 1 papers of 2023 and 2025 and a chemistry paper); Crossref titles on YK-029A: phase 1 abstracts and papers only. Puhe is unlisted; its own news list was read (puhebiopharma.com/companynews/index.html, latest item 2026-03-04): no readout, filing or interim analysis; a company article of 2025-12-24 and the pipeline page list PH001 with no phase 3 result, and the site still carries the patient-recruitment notice for this indication. One Chinese web search: registry mirrors only (one mirror of China's register shows the trial as recruiting; summary, not opened). Estimated completion date (Jul 2025) is past.

Re-check 2026-10-09. SHR-1701-III-310 (SHR-1701 = retlirafusp alfa; with bevacizumab and chemotherapy after EGFR-TKI failure): no disclosure found. Registry (API): status unknown, no results, no sites, never updated since first posting on 2021-11-24. A mirror of China's register (CTR20212944, pharnexcloud.com, opened, undated) shows 'recruiting', first patient 2022-02-15, target 561, no completion or termination date. Hengrui documents: all 40 of its notices with 'accepted' in the title from June 2024 to 9 Oct 2026 were opened (cninfo); the only retlirafusp filing is gastric cancer (20 Sep 2024), approved Jan 2026. The H1 2025 report (20 Aug 2025) pipeline chart lists SHR-1701 for gastric / gastro-oesophageal junction cancer only, and the 2025 annual report (25 Mar 2026) and H1 2026 report (19 Aug 2026) name no lung indication: the lung programme has dropped out of the pipeline without a statement. Hengrui has issued no notice with 'endpoint' in the title since 2022, so a negative or abandoned trial would not be announced. Europe PMC and Crossref titles (SHR-1701 / retlirafusp + lung): phase 2 neoadjuvant papers only; the JCO phase 3 of Sept 2026 is the gastric sibling. One Chinese web search: nothing. Two-stage design (stage I safety run-in, stage II PFS).

Re-check 2026-10-09. SHR-A1921-303 (TROP2 ADC vs chemotherapy, platinum-resistant ovarian cancer): no disclosure found. Registry (API): recruiting, started 2024-05-10, no results, estimated completion 2026-05-31, last updated 2024-08-09. A mirror of China's register (CTR20241535, pharnexcloud.com, opened, undated) shows 'recruiting', first patient 2024-05-16, target 440. Hengrui documents: none of its 40 'accepted' notices from June 2024 to 9 Oct 2026 concerns SHR-A1921 (all opened, cninfo); the H1 2025 report (20 Aug 2025) pipeline chart lists SHR-A1921 as a TROP2 ADC for ovarian cancer; the 2025 annual report (25 Mar 2026, https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0325/2026032502087_c.pdf) mentions it only in a list of publications and it is absent from the table of approvals expected 2026-2028; the H1 2026 report (19 Aug 2026) does not mention it. That pattern suggests the programme was dropped, but no source says the trial was stopped. Europe PMC and Crossref titles on SHR-A1921: phase 1 (incl. ESMO 2024 717MO in this setting), phase 2 salivary and preclinical only. One Chinese web search: nothing.

Re-check 2026-10-09. EndoTAG-1 (SB05) CT4005, triple-negative breast cancer, Taiwan: no primary analysis disclosed and no sign one was done. Registry (API): suspended ('study design reconsideration'), enrolment still an estimate (420), 6 Taiwanese sites, no results, last updated 2023-04-26. SynCore documents read: material-information list (syncorebio.com/about/investor/events/) has no item on this trial from 2019 on (the two notices of 18 May 2022 concern the pancreatic trial CTA68, not CT4005); the investor deck of 13 Dec 2023 calls CT-4005 a 'human dose safety trial' in triple-negative breast cancer; the deck of 17 Aug 2026 lists EndoTAG only as a platform for reformulation, with no breast trial, and a company item of that date describes a move away from drug development. Europe PMC (title EndoTAG: nothing since 2016; by NCT: reviews), Crossref titles (latest EndoTAG abstract is the pancreatic trial CT4006 at ESMO Asia 2022, a sibling), EDGAR. One web search: nothing. Looks abandoned before the randomised stage enrolled, but no source says it was terminated, so it is not coded terminated_no_analysis.

Re-check 2026-10-09; first trace confirmed, no earlier disclosure found. GSK headline-results announcement of 20 Dec 2024 (6-K copy opened): FIRST-ENGOT-OV44 'met its primary endpoint of PFS demonstrating a statistically significant difference'; OS (key secondary) not significant; no numbers. Earlier documents: EDGAR full text shows only two GSK filings naming ENGOT-OV44 (20 Dec 2024 and the FY results of 5 Feb 2025); GSK's Q3 2024 results (6-K of 30 Oct 2024, opened) list 'FIRST (1L maintenance ovarian cancer) - Phase III data readout' under news flow anticipated in H2 2024, so the result was not public seven weeks before. HR 0.85 (95% CI 0.73-0.99, p=0.0351) read in OncLive coverage of ASCO 2025 LBA5506 dated 2 June 2025, in the Annals of Oncology paper e-published the same day (PMID 40461381, doi 10.1016/j.annonc.2025.05.009) and in the registry results (posted 2025-12-31). The ASCO session day was not confirmed; it may have been 1 June.

Re-check 2026-10-09. Hemay022 (sacibertinib) + aromatase inhibitor vs lapatinib + capecitabine (HM022BC3C01): still enrolling, no readout. Registry (API): recruiting, no results, last updated 2025-04-22. Ganzhou Hemay Pharmaceutical, parent of the registry sponsor (Tianjin Hemay Pharmaceutical is its wholly-owned subsidiary), has a live Hong Kong listing application; its application proof of 8 June 2026 (https://www1.hkexnews.hk/app/sehk/2026/108622/documents/sehk26060801665.pdf, latest practicable date 1 June 2026) was read: Hemay022 'is undergoing a Phase III clinical trial in China', enrolment has been 'slower-than-anticipated', 'we anticipate completing enrollment by the end of 2026', NDA planned for 2027. Europe PMC and Crossref: the phase 1 paper and phase 1b abstracts only. No web search needed. The registry's estimated completion date (2025-12) is out of date.

Re-check 2026-10-09. XZP-3621 (dirozalkib, formerly 'dexitinib'; trial later named DIAMOND-2) vs crizotinib. Earliest statement of the result I could open: Sihuan Pharmaceutical's Hong Kong voluntary announcement of 22 Aug 2025 on the NMPA approval: 'In pivotal Phase III clinical trials, Dirozalkib demonstrated significantly superior efficacy compared to the marketed first- and second-generation ALK inhibitors'. It names neither PFS, crizotinib nor a registry number; this is the drug's only phase 3. The first document that states the PFS result is Xuanzhu's post-hearing listing document of 17 Sep 2025 (the first trace's source, re-read): primary endpoint (investigator-assessed PFS) met at an interim analysis with data cut-off 8 Jan 2024, median not reached vs 12.94 months, HR 0.422 (95% CI 0.279-0.638), p<0.0001; the trial was not stopped. Fuller data at AACR 2026 (abstract CT299, 17 Apr 2026; company notice of 19 Apr 2026 as reported: HR 0.47). THE TRUE FIRST DISCLOSURE IS PROBABLY EARLIER and could not be opened: Xuanzhu's first application proof was filed on 25 Nov 2024 and a second on 13 June 2025; the exchange has withdrawn both, the Wayback Machine holds only error pages for them, and two news reports of Nov 2024 that were opened do not quote the result. Earlier Sihuan documents opened hint without stating it: annual results of 28 Mar 2024 ('has achieved phased results', filing expected in 2024); filing-accepted notice of 2 May 2024 and interim results of 30 Aug 2024 (higher response rate than marketed drugs, no PFS); annual results of 28 Mar 2025 (phase III response rate compared with other drugs' trials, no PFS). Xuanzhu's own news list has no item on the trial before 25 Aug 2025. No conference abstract before AACR 2026 found (Europe PMC, Crossref). Three web searches.
